settings.meaning: charset is the column's CHARACTER SET. on_update is the expression of its ON UPDATE clause. A setting left out is not stated.

ptah.run/mysql/column-settings.constraint: At least one setting is present. Values are trimmed text without NUL. The value states the clauses a CREATE TABLE, ADD COLUMN or MODIFY COLUMN writes; it never becomes a change on its own.
At least one setting is present. charset is what information_schema.COLUMNS reports, including a character set the column inherits from its table. on_update is the expression EXTRA names.

canonicalization: Strings are UTF-8 and kept verbatim, including case. Property order carries no meaning.
